question: What is the meaning of ability of the product to improve air quality by pollutant capture in relation to environmental benefits?
data_point: ability of the product to improve air quality by pollutant capture
description: The ability of a product to improve air quality by pollutant capture refers to the environmental benefit of reducing air pollution. This benefit is achieved when the product effectively captures and neutralizes pollutants in the air, thereby improving the overall air quality. This is part of the broader environmental benefits that result from improving the quality of resources, including materials in the product and resources affected by the product's use. <||>
